content.short: Mode is an Ethereum Layer 2 network designed for hyper-growth and rewarding users for ecosystem contributions.
content.description: Mode is a pioneering modular Ethereum Layer 2 network built on the OP Stack, designed to foster a more rewarding and sustainable ecosystem for developers and users. By utilizing an innovative 'On-chain Referral' system and sharing sequencer revenue with ecosystem participants, Mode aligns the interests of all contributors to drive hyper-growth. The network offers a high-performance environment with near-instant transactions and extremely low fees, while maintaining the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. Mode focuses on supporting a vibrant library of dApps, from high-frequency DeFi to social and gaming, serving as a critical engine for the mass adoption of decentralized innovation and modular blockchain infrastructure.
content.meta: Mode is a premier modular Ethereum Layer 2 network, offering high scalability, low fees, and innovative user reward models for decentralized apps.
